## Functions

### `Testimonial`

```ts
Testimonial(props: TestimonialProps): Html
```

One customer's words, with who said them.

### `TestimonialGrid`

```ts
TestimonialGrid(props: TestimonialGridProps): Html
```

Several testimonials in columns (one on a phone).

## Types

### `TestimonialVariant`

A bordered card, a plain quote on the page ground, or one large pull quote.

- `"card"`
- `"plain"`
- `"large"`

### `TestimonialProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `quote` | `string | Html` | yes |  |
| `name` | `string` | yes |  |
| `role` | `string` |  | Title and company — "CTO, Northwind". |
| `avatar` | `Html` |  | An `Avatar(...)`. |
| `logo` | `Html` |  | The customer's logo (an `<img>` or an inline SVG), shown at the top. |
| `rating` | `number` |  | 1–5, drawn as stars. |
| `variant` | `TestimonialVariant` |  |  |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |

### `TestimonialGridProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `TestimonialProps[]` | yes |  |
| `columns` | `"2" | "3"` |  | Columns from 768px up. @default "3" |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### One large quote

```ts
Testimonial({
  quote: "We stopped chasing. The reminders go out, the money comes in.",
  name: "Priya Natarajan",
  role: "Founder, Northwind Traders",
  avatar: Avatar({ initials: "PN", size: "sm" }),
  variant: "large",
})
```

```html
<figure class="testimonial testimonial--large">
  <blockquote class="testimonial__quote">We stopped chasing. The reminders go out, the money comes in.</blockquote>
  <figcaption class="testimonial__by">
    <span class="testimonial__avatar">
      <span class="avatar avatar--sm">PN</span>
    </span>
    <span class="testimonial__who">
      <span class="testimonial__name">Priya Natarajan</span>
      <span class="testimonial__role">Founder, Northwind Traders</span>
    </span>
  </figcaption>
</figure>
```

### Three customers in a row

```ts
TestimonialGrid({
  items: [
    {
      quote: "Days-sales-outstanding went from 41 to 19.",
      name: "Marcus Thorne",
      role: "CFO, Contoso",
      rating: 5,
    },
    {
      quote: "The first tool our accountant kept.",
      name: "Jamie Sun",
      role: "Operations, Fabrikam",
      rating: 4,
    },
    { quote: "Set up in an afternoon.", name: "Alex Rivera", role: "Owner, Globex", rating: 5 },
  ],
})
```

